review_method: Codex visual inspection of both generated contact sheets
result: No gross axis reversal, transpose error, frame mismatch or large registration displacement was observed in these eight examples.
observations: Bedroom furniture and chair silhouettes occupy corresponding RGB and depth locations.
Kitchen refrigerator and cabinet boundaries correspond to depth discontinuities.
Dining and reception chair outlines, bookstore layout and bathroom sink silhouette correspond across modalities.
Raw depth contains extensive missing regions around reflective, low-return and image-border areas; these were preserved rather than filled by the converter.
limits: This verifies representative visual consistency and the source registration was preserved exactly, not a new subpixel calibration.
Raw sensor noise and occlusion-edge offsets remain. Not all RGB texture edges are depth edges.
Filled reference depth includes NYU's original inpainting and must not be described as independently measured dense sensor ground truth.
source_spatial_operation: Axis transpose only; no resize, crop, additional reprojection or warp
